No account, ads, subscriptions, analytics or network access. Profile, goals, running records and app-owned details stay in private local storage. Health Connect access is optional and read-only. Android automatic backup and device transfer are excluded; explicit local export is available in the main app.

This app provides fitness guidance, not medical care. Training recommendations do not guarantee results or prevent injury. If you experience chest pain, fainting, severe difficulty breathing or serious injury symptoms, stop exercise and seek appropriate medical advice.
Optional Health Connect import is available in the main app. You can always continue without it.

Full third-party notices are available in main app Settings and bundled offline assets. Build tooling includes Gradle and Android Gradle Plugin. No proprietary training plans are bundled.
